Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 temp_x varchar2(1);
BEGIN
 SELECT 'x' INTO temp_x 
 FROM vserv_master 
 WHERE code_type = 'LTYPE'
 AND code = :ctrl_blk_1.warehouse_id
 AND sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate);
EXCEPTION
 WHEN no_data_found THEN 
 show_error_dist('0350');
 WHEN others THEN
 handle_error;
END;

Item.Name: BLOOD_TYPE_DESC
Item.Hint: Enter blood type or use [LISTVAL]; else leave blank

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_abo VARCHAR2(4);
 temp_desc VARCHAR2(20);
begin
 if :blood_type_desc is not null
 then
 parse_abo('M', temp_abo, temp_desc);
 BEGIN
 SELECT 'x'
 INTO :GLOBAL.x
 FROM vserv_abo v
 WHERE abo_code = temp_abo AND identifier_code = 'RG'
 AND rownum < 2
 AND exists ( SELECT 'x'
 FROM set_inventory_levels
 WHERE blood_type = v.abo_code)
 AND sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate + 365);
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 show_error_dist('0300');
 check_package_failure;
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END;
 :ctrl_blk_1.blood_type_desc := temp_desc;
 :ctrl_blk_1.blood_type := temp_abo;
 else
 :ctrl_blk_1.blood_type := '';
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_count number := 0;
begin
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 go_query('active_info');
 if :active_info.unit_id is null
 then
 message('Msg: No matching products found');
 go_block('ctrl_blk_1');
 else
 go_record('1');
 loop
 temp_count := temp_count + 1;
 exit when :system.last_record = 'TRUE';
 down;
 end loop;
 :s_unit_found := temp_count;
 first_record;
 execute_trigger('populate_attrib');
 go_query('antigen_info');
 go_block('active_info');
 end if;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: POPULATE_AG_CODES_INFO
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE populate_ag_codes_info(unit_id_in IN VARCHAR2) IS
BEGIN
 go_block('ag_codes_info');
 
 clear_block(no_validate);
 
 first_record;
 
 
 FOR rec IN ( SELECT
 ag_hdr.antigen_code, ag_hdr.confirm_flag
 FROM
 ag_donor_tests_hdr ag_hdr, donations dn
 WHERE
 ag_hdr.donor_id = dn.donor_id
 AND dn.unit_id = unit_id_in)
 LOOP
 
 :ag_codes_info.antigen_code := rec.antigen_code;
 :ag_codes_info.confirm_flag := rec.confirm_flag;
 
 next_record;
 
 END LOOP;
 
 first_record;
 

END;

Trigger.Name: POPULATE_ATTRIB
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 cursor c1 is
 select attrib_code, attrib_desc
 from vserv_attributes va
 where normal_stock_flag = 'Y'
 AND nvl(unit_scheme_type,'C') =decode(:active_info.chk_digit,NULL,'C','I')
 and sysdate between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date,sysdate+365)
 and (exists
 (select distinct attrib_code, attrib_group
 from component_attributes
 where unit_id = :active_info.unit_id
 and coll_date = :active_info.coll_date
 and chapter_id = :s_chapter_id
 and product_code = :active_info.product_code
 and attrib_group = va.attrib_group
 and attrib_code = va.attrib_code)
 or exists
 (select attrib_code, attrib_group
 from unit_attributes
 where unit_id = :active_info.unit_id
 and coll_date = :active_info.coll_date
 and chapter_id = :s_chapter_id
 and attrib_group = va.attrib_group
 and attrib_code = va.attrib_code))
 order by 1;
begin
 go_block('attrib_info');
 clear_block(NO_VALIDATE);
 for c1_rec in c1
 loop
 :attrib_info.attrib_code := c1_rec.attrib_code;
 :s_attrib_desc := c1_rec.attrib_desc;
 down;
 end loop;
 clear_record;
end;
